title: Local and hosted costs under two demand levels
method: Synthetic cost model, not market pricing. Local cost = 1,800 + 0.001 × monthly completed requests; hosted cost = 0.01 × requests. Break-even is 200,000 requests under equal quality and service assumptions. Real token lengths, redundancy and operations change the result.
alt: Local and hosted costs under two demand levels. Local: 100k requests: 1900 assumed USD per month, Hosted: 100k requests: 1000 assumed USD per month, Local: 300k requests: 2100 assumed USD per month, Hosted: 300k requests: 3000 assumed USD per month. Illustrative data.
